comparison.objective: Jog a desktop CNC cutter over a cross mark using a spring-centred joystick.
comparison.physical_skill: Closed-loop joystick actuation and visual tool positioning, not direct mandrel alignment and hammer striking.
comparison.success_condition: Cutter positioned over the mark; positional tolerance and prohibited-contact rules are unavailable.
comparison.reason: It tests mediated motion control and visual registration, not physical fracture, coil preservation, or fragment recovery.
